title: Six test fixtures report failures that name the wrong file
query: Two test cases report that a validator passed a broken tree, when the tree was never broken: the mutation helper's anchor string no longer exists. Fix the helper so a mutation that cannot be applied says so.
oracle: One helper, but the reasoning is the point: a guard that fires wrongly is worse than one that never fires, because it sends the reader to the wrong file and the failure is indistinguishable from a real finding. Recognising that is R2. Inline because the change is three lines in one file once the principle is understood.
